rows.grounds: locative indicating the dimension of width
compound specifying a division into five parts
locative indicating the dimension of length
particle extending the rule to another dimension

items.question: What proportional division must be applied to both the width and the length of the prescribed structure?
premises: The width is assigned a division into five parts.
The length is included in the same proportional prescription.
The same rule applies to the length as to the width.
items.inference: Both the width and the length should be divided into five parts in the same manner.
items.plain_english: In the width there should be a five-part division, and in the length also it should be the same.
